packageRules.description: CI here is advisory, not a merge gate, so every update waits for the local checks, the Codex review and a manual merge.
The CI container is a numbered Ubuntu release; dated or code-name tags such as stonking-20261105.1 are not candidates.

shellcheck is maintained (commits and merges through 2026-11) but its releases from v0.8.0 (2021-11) to v0.11.0 (2025-08) came 13 to 17 months apart, so the default 1-year abandonment threshold flags it (koalaman/shellcheck#3609). cpplint keeps the default: its maintainer gap is real (cpplint/cpplint#402).
